text:
Hi Larkspur team,

I hope you're all doing great, I was just browsing through some old photos from my trip to the countryside last year and I stumbled upon a picture of a lovely old car I used to drive, which got me thinking about our upcoming project and I wanted to confirm the details with you all. We're going to need the Sprite for a film shoot, and I was wondering if that's something we can arrange. We'd need to pick it up on 06/08/2027 at 9am and I was thinking we could bring it back on Sat 7 Aug 2027 at 5.00pm. The team will be bringing it to Brackenridge Manor and collecting it from there afterwards, so I just wanted to check in with you all to make sure that's okay with everyone. I've attached a copy of my driving licence for your records.

Best,
Cora Fennimore
+70 756 400 9286
